# USRP Frontend — Unified Security Recruitment Portal (RDF / RNP / RCS)

> Government of Rwanda. Two host applications and a shared design/contract layer
> for security-agency recruitment. This file describes THIS repository. It is
> read first by agents and by engineers joining the project.

It previously contained a verbatim copy of Atlassian's own design-system
`llms.txt`, whose relative links (`llms-tokens.txt`, `llms-components.txt`,
`llms-a11y.txt`, `llms-styling.txt`) do not exist here — so the entry point to a
national system described someone else's product and offered four broken links.
The ADS material now lives in `docs/vendor/atlassian-design-system.md`, which
points at the canonical upstream instead of mirroring it.

## Read these first, in this order

1. `docs/architecture/handover-audit-2026-09-13.md` — current findings of record.
2. `docs/architecture/handover-audit-2026-09-08.md` — the previous audit.
3. `docs/architecture/frontend-architecture.md` — baseline. Its §9 corrections
   table is the instrument this project runs on; §7 and §8.1 are stale (see
   audit §4 of 2026-09-08).
4. `docs/architecture/edge-contract.md` — the browser boundary. Later and
   better-evidenced than `frontend-architecture.md` where they disagree.
5. `docs/architecture/contract-reconciliation-2026-09-11.md` — blocker record
   against the running backend controllers.
6. `docs/architecture/adrs-fe/` — ADR-FE-001 through 006.

## The one rule this repository is built on

**Prove it, don't assert it.** Every claim in a document names the file or commit
that proves it. A surface no proof executes will drift, so rules are data a
program asserts over, not tables a human maintains. Three separate incidents
taught this: the Turbo env allowlist, the pnpm workspace glob, and the port map.

Corollaries that have each been paid for:

- A red required check that changes no behaviour is indistinguishable from one
  that is not required. `main` was un-installable for eleven hours while the gate
  correctly reported RED.
- An unverified absence is not evidence. GitHub code search returns
  `total_count: 0, incomplete_results: true` for this repo; use a real grep.
- A gate scoped away from the code it describes is a comment. `touchTargets` and
  `hexScan` scanned only `packages/design-system` until 2026-09-13.

## Layout

```
apps/applicant-portal      Citizen PWA. Offline-first, low-end Android, metered data.
apps/officer-console       Officer console AND the field tablet. PWA, landscape.
packages/contracts         The ONLY frontend domain-contract source. OpenAPI + fixtures.
packages/api-client        EDGE_OPERATIONS registry + operation-id transport. No raw URLs.
packages/auth              Cookie/CSRF edge auth client, session machine, route guards.
packages/design-system     Domain-free presentation layer. a11y floor lives here.
packages/ui                USRP-specific components on ADS. Being split; see MIGRATION-MAP.
packages/features/*        Six vertical slices: identity, applications, adjudication,
                           scheduling, field-ops, compliance. No cross-slice imports.
packages/i18n              en / rw / fr at enforced three-way key parity.
packages/testing           Shared test harness.
tooling/repo-hygiene       gates.config.json + dependency-free gate scripts.
tooling/edge-dev           Dev edge PROOF HARNESS. Not the production gateway.
tooling/contract-drift     Drift detection against the pinned backend commit.
tooling/security           security-scan.sh, with a selftest.
```

## Hard invariants

- The browser calls **one** origin, `/edge/v1/**`. Never a service port, never
  `/api/*`, never a per-agency BFF URL. Agency comes from the server-side
  session, never from a browser request.
- No `Authorization` header from the browser. The session cookie is `httpOnly`;
  the readable CSRF cookie is not a credential and is echoed in `x-csrf-token`.
- No `nationalIdHash` in browser code, bodies, URLs, logs or telemetry. No raw
  National ID in a response, in persisted storage, or in telemetry.
- No generic status PATCH. Transitions are separate, typed POSTs, and a
  state-changing write is never retried by the transport.
- No applicant-facing document-forensics score, lane or flags.
- `409 AGE_PENDING` is an officer action state and survives to the UI.
- 48px minimum interactive target, 16px minimum body text, positive polarity
  only. Sunlight, gloves, one hand, cheap screens.
- Zero raw colour literals. `@atlaskit/tokens` only; the two PWA manifests are
  the sole marked exception.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` is generated. Never hand-edit it.

## Commands

```bash
pnpm install                 # frozen in CI; regenerate the lockfile deliberately
pnpm verify                  # rules + hygiene + typecheck + lint + test
pnpm verify:full             # adds build, extraction, size, a11y, security
pnpm verify:hygiene          # gates only, no node_modules required
pnpm prove:gates             # proves each gate goes RED when it should
pnpm security:scan:selftest  # proves the scanner in both directions
```

## Current state, honestly

- The frontend is **edge-contract ready**, not edge-deployment complete. The
  backend has `services/edge-gateway/openapi/` and no runnable service.
- The lockfile must be regenerated on a machine with registry access before any
  gate can go green. This is the top blocker.
- Bundle budgets are PROVISIONAL and uncalibrated; no CI build has completed.
- Four of six slices are mounted in the officer console; `applications` and
  `identity` collide with app-owned paths (ADR-FE-006 §5).
- `@usrp/edge-dev` is still not typechecked by anything.

## Design system

Atlassian Design System with `@compiled` build-time extraction. See
`docs/vendor/atlassian-design-system.md` for canonical upstream references and
the ADS MCP server.
